server.name: community-rive
server.version: rive-mcp-server (npm latest at image build time)
server.note: Drawn in frame order at position 349 of Frame 3; re-entered under amendment 9.8 (its declared binary is rive-mcp). Thirty five tools, none annotated. riv_setup copies a bundled skill into a client's skills directory; it is exercised only at project scope, which lands inside the trial root. Rendering and network asset search are not exercised. riv_create validates with a headless Chromium the image does not have; the profile is stated here so its rows are read as rows under this profile. riv_edit is not exercised, since its only source of a .riv is that same tool.

fixtures.note: Creates a .riv with one shape at a caller-named path.
Copies the bundled skill into the project's .claude/skills.
